```sql
SELECT count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
JOIN reference.regions r ON o.region_code = r.region_code
WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Sydney%'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-03-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
```
